name: Tissot Indicatrix
desc: A field of Tissot's indicatrices spread across a flexing map graticule — small circles that swell, shear and elongate into ellipses to reveal exactly how each map projection distorts area and angle, false-coloured by their distortion so the poles bloom huge in Mercator and pinch to slivers in the sinusoidal as the projection endlessly morphs beneath them.
